5.1.1_planetary_tier_system.description: Planets have 5 tiers, unlocked through progression
5.1.1_planetary_tier_system.unlock_progression: Tier increases through: XP milestones, specific achievements, or direct upgrade purchase

tier_effects.tier_3: +2 max KP cap (12 total), +10% damage with offensive glyphs
tier_effects.tier_4: Ultimate glyphs cost -1 KP, +20% all offensive effects

5.1.2_sun_mechanics.counterplay: Strong early game, resource denial counters

tier_effects.tier_3: +20 max Restoration cap (90 total), [Regen] effects last +2 turns
tier_effects.tier_4: Healing can grant temporary overheal (up to 120% max HP), +5% HP regeneration per turn below 50% HP

tier_effects.tier_4: Tantra glyphs cost -20% Prana, [Burn] damage increased by 1 per stack (4/stack instead of 3/stack)

tier_effects.tier_3: +15 max Sanctity cap (75 total), +2 max KP cap (12 total), +20 max Grace cap (120 total)
tier_effects.tier_4: Grace overflow triggers at 80 (instead of 100), all Invocation effects +25%, can activate 2 glyphs per turn (once per match)

5.1.6_jupiter_mechanics.scaling_powerhouse: Late-game dominance through Grace and resource caps

tier_effects.tier_3: +20% all resource generation, resource conversions cost -1 turn cooldown
tier_effects.tier_4: Can convert resources 2:1 ratio (instead of 3:1), +30% healing, +15% damage, perfect balance bonus

5.1.7_venus_mechanics.flexible: Enables hybrid builds and resource flexibility

tier_effects.tier_4: [Shield] effects +50%, Structure overflow grants +2 Defense (instead of +1 per 5), immune to first lethal damage per round

tier_effects.tier_2: +3 Coherence per turn, pattern detection enhanced (+1 Coherence per pattern)

tier_effects.tier_4: Detect patterns 1 turn earlier, [Collapse] instant-win becomes easier, +40% Singularity effects

LAYER_7_AI_DECISION_LOGIC.description: Rules for AI opponent behavior and decision-making

7.1_AI_DIFFICULTY_LEVELS.description: Multiple AI difficulty tiers with different behaviors

7.1.1_difficulty_tiers.description: 5 AI difficulty levels from beginner to legendary

tiers.behavior: Random glyph selection, no strategy, frequent misplays
Basic strategy, favors damage over defense, simple combos
Strategic play, adapts to player strategy, uses synergies
Near-optimal play, complex combos, baits and punishes
Perfect play, unbeatable without player skill/luck, tournament-level
tiers.reaction_time: 4-5 second thinking delay (simulates human pro player)
tiers.prediction: Expert (predicts player glyphs 80% accuracy, counters strategies)

7.1.2_AI_decision_priority.description: How AI prioritizes actions based on difficulty

7.2_AI_LEARNING_SYSTEM.description: How AI adapts to player behavior (higher difficulties)

7.2.1_pattern_recognition.description: AI tracks player patterns to predict and counter
7.2.1_pattern_recognition.adaptation: After 3-5 turns, AI adjusts strategy based on detected patterns
7.2.1_pattern_recognition.counterplay: Player must vary strategy to avoid being countered

counter_strategies.ai_counter: Prioritize [Shield], heal at 60% HP, [Sanctify] for damage reduction
Apply heal block, [Curse], resource denial, finish quickly before heals stack
Use [Anchor], prioritize resource generation glyphs, save KP for counters
Randomize glyph selection, use unpredictable patterns, [Silence] to stop predictions
Vary actions every turn, avoid repetition, deny Coherence generation

LAYER_8_EDGE_CASES.description: Handling rare scenarios, bugs, and unusual situations

8.1_SIMULTANEOUS_EVENTS.description: What happens when multiple events occur at exact same time

8.1.1_simultaneous_defeat.description: Both cards reach 0 HP on same turn
8.1.1_simultaneous_defeat.resolution: Round declared draw, rematch with same cards
8.1.1_simultaneous_defeat.round_score: No player gets round win, round count doesn't increment

8.1.2_simultaneous_resource_depletion.description: Both players run out of KP simultaneously
8.1.2_simultaneous_resource_depletion.resolution: Both pass turn, resources regenerate next turn normally
8.1.2_simultaneous_resource_depletion.note: Not a draw condition, game continues

8.1.3_simultaneous_instant_win_condition.resolution: Priority to player who achieved condition first (by turn order)
8.1.3_simultaneous_instant_win_condition.tiebreaker: If truly simultaneous, higher Speed stat wins
8.1.3_simultaneous_instant_win_condition.ultra_rare: Theoretically possible but never observed in testing

policy.reconnection_success: Match resumes from exact game state
policy.repeat_disconnections: 3 disconnections in 24 hours → Ranked matchmaking temporarily suspended (30 minutes)

casual_vs_ranked.casual: More lenient, 90 second window, no penalties
casual_vs_ranked.ranked: 60 second window, loss of Glory points on forfeit

8.3_BUG_HANDLING.description: How system handles unexpected errors or bugs

8.3.1_bug_detection_and_recovery.description: Automatic bug detection and graceful degradation
detection_methods: Invalid game state (HP negative, resources exceed cap)
Missing required data (card/glyph definitions not found)
recovery_actions: Log error to server for developer review
Attempt state correction (clamp values to valid ranges)
If unrecoverable: Declare match draw, refund entry fees/Glory
Notify player with error ID for support ticket
8.3.1_bug_detection_and_recovery.player_communication: Friendly error message: 'Something went wrong! Match result nullified, rewards refunded. Error ID: [code]'

detection_methods: Impossible actions (activate glyph without sufficient resources)
Speed hacking (actions faster than humanly possible)

response.severe_offense: Immediate permanent ban (e.g., selling hacked accounts)

LAYER_9_SPECIAL_MECHANICS.description: Tournament rules, achievements, seasonal events, and special modes

formats.description: Everyone plays 5-7 rounds, ranked by wins
formats.advantages: No elimination, all players get multiple matches
formats.reward_structure: Top 8 receive rewards based on final standings

formats.rewards: Exclusive cosmetics, titles, massive Essence/Crystal prizes

rules: Deck lock: Cannot change deck between matches in same tournament
Time limits: 60 second turn timer strictly enforced
Pause limit: 1 pause per player per match, max 60 seconds
Disconnection: 30 second window (stricter than casual), then forfeit
Spectators: Matches can be spectated with 30-second delay (prevents ghosting)
Prize distribution: Top 50% receive participation rewards minimum

achievements: Engine Master: Reach Master tier in all 8 engines (Reward: 1000 Essence, 'Omniscient' title)
Planetary Alignment: Unlock all planets to Tier 4 (Reward: 2000 Essence, exclusive card art)
Perfect Victory: Win without taking damage 10 times (Reward: 500 Essence, 'Untouchable' title)
Pyromaniac: Apply [Burn] 5 stacks 50 times (Reward: Unlock 'Inferno' glyph)
Detonator: Execute [Detonate] with 5 stacks 20 times (Reward: 300 Essence)
Healer: Heal 10,000 HP total (Reward: Unlock 'Greater Heal' glyph)
Checkmate Master: Win via [Checkmate] 5 times (Reward: 1000 Essence, 'Grandmaster' title)
Singularity Achieved: Win via [Collapse] 3 times (Reward: 1500 Essence, exclusive cosmetic)
Divine Intervention: Win with Grace at 100 (Reward: 500 Essence)
Glyph Collector: Unlock 500 unique glyphs (Reward: 2000 Essence, 'Archivist' title)
Deckbuilder: Create 50 unique decks (Reward: +2 deck slots)
Completionist: Unlock all 800 glyphs (Reward: 5000 Essence, 'Transcendent' title, exclusive cosmetic set)
Ranked Rookie: Reach Bronze rank (Reward: 100 Glory)
Gold Standard: Reach Gold rank (Reward: 500 Glory, exclusive card back)
Legendary Warrior: Reach Legendary rank (Reward: 2000 Glory, exclusive animated card back, 'Legend' title)

seasons.special_rewards: Fire-themed cosmetics, +20% Prana generation for duration

seasons.event_modes: Ascension mode: Neural States cost -5 Bandwidth to transition

modes.description: Random glyphs each turn, unpredictable gameplay
Players draft cards from shared pool, build deck on-the-fly
modes.rewards: Based on wins (0-5 wins = tiered rewards)

Both players use identical random decks
modes.pure_skill: Eliminates deck advantage, tests pure strategy

cosmetics.examples: Fire trail for [Burn], holy light for [Bless], glitch effect for Singularity

VALIDATION_FRAMEWORK.description: Final validation and cross-layer rule checking
validation_layers: Layer 1-3: Core game mechanics (match flow, resources, combat)
Layer 5: Jyotish modifiers applied to all previous layers
Layer 6: Progression unlocks validated against player level
Layer 7: AI behavior selected based on difficulty + player patterns
Layer 8: Edge case handling if anomalies detected
Layer 9: Special mode rules override base rules when active
rule_priority: 1. Special mode rules (highest priority, override base rules)
5. Default behavior (when no specific rule applies)
VALIDATION_FRAMEWORK.conflict_resolution: If rules conflict, higher priority wins; log conflict for developer review
